EngLawName: Organic Act for Social Development and Long-Term Care Administration under Ministry of Health and Welfare
name: 衛生福利部社會發展及長期照顧署組織法
histories: All 6 articles promulgated by Presidential order Hua-Zong-Yi-Yi-Zi No. 11500094181 on September 30, 2026；date of implementation to be determined by the Executive Yuan.

articles.content: The Social Development and Long-Term Care Administration (hereinafter referred to as the Administration) is to be established by the Ministry of Health and Welfare to engage in affairs related to the policies of long-term care, senior citizens, people with physical and mental disabilities, and the national pension program.

The Administration shall have one director-general whose rank shall be equivalent to or at Grade 13 for selected appointment, and two deputy directors-generals ranked at Grade 12 for selected appointment.
Regarding the appointment of the director-general mentioned in the preceding paragraph, priority shall be given to candidates with ex-officio posts.
The Administration shall have a chief secretary ranked at Grade 11 for selected appointment.
The official ranks, grades and quotas for the positions within the Administration will be stipulated separately via an organizational chart.
The effective date of this Act shall be stipulated by the Executive Yuan in the form of orders.
